title: GLM-5.3-Flash CSF on two Sparks (a pair) with decode-context parallelism 2 (research-only)
evidence_scope: mHC row ownership on, KDA prefill coalescing off, 16 requests with CUDA graphs to 64 tokens, on the source-derived dcp2-prefill image: hand-made containers of these settings on a pair of an eight-Spark ring held 4,126,165 KV tokens, passed a seven-prompt correctness screen and measured prefill within 2 % of the 8-request settings at 16K and 2 % above at 64K and 128K, with 142-145 tok/s aggregate decode at 16 requests (performance/records/images/dcp2-prefill-e91876-glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2-dcp2-settings-20261013.md); single runs; not serving-qualified. Earlier evidence for the 8-request settings with both features off follows: The csf deployment of glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2 (local-inference-lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD at dec48abd33ef) with decode-context parallelism 2, --cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 4, mHC prefill row ownership and KDA prefill coalescing off and 14 GiB of KV cache per Spark, on installer image dev-20261010-kraken-csf-sircl032-libsircl060cd-plugins-status036 (d52737a109e0): one start of these settings, as the installer's DCP1 containers re-created with the profile's rendered differences rather than a sparkring install of the profile, on a pair of an eight-Spark ring held 4,126,165 KV tokens, passed 7 of 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate, wrong or failed response, and against the DCP1 profile's csf deployment on the same pair ran decode 1-6 % fewer engine steps per second and prefill 17 % slower at 64K and 128K (performance/records/images/dev-20261010-kraken-csf-sircl032-libsircl060cd-plugins-status036-glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2-dcp2-pair-20261013.md); single-run timing; image and video memory loads not measured; not serving-qualified.
